utterances.speaker: Speaker 1
utterances.text: Good morning everyone, thanks for joining the planning call.

utterances.speaker: Speaker 2
utterances.text: Morning. I have the supplier quotes ready, there are three of them.

utterances.speaker: Speaker 1
utterances.text: Great. Which one is the cheapest for the first batch of two hundred units?

utterances.speaker: Speaker 2
utterances.text: The second supplier, at four dollars twenty a unit, with delivery in ten days.

utterances.speaker: Speaker 3
utterances.text: The first supplier is slower but their quality record is much better than the others.

utterances.speaker: Speaker 1
utterances.text: Let us not decide on price alone. Priya, can you check the quality reports before Friday?

utterances.speaker: Speaker 3
utterances.text: Yes, I will review the reports and send a short summary to the team by Thursday evening.

utterances.speaker: Speaker 2
utterances.text: I will also ask the second supplier whether they can improve the delivery time.

utterances.speaker: Speaker 1
utterances.text: Good. We still need an owner for the budget approval, that should be Marcus.

utterances.speaker: Speaker 3
utterances.text: Marcus is on leave until Monday, so the approval will wait until next week.

utterances.speaker: Speaker 1
utterances.text: That is fine. We will decide on the supplier at the Tuesday meeting.

utterances.speaker: Speaker 2
utterances.text: Sounds good. Thanks everyone, talk to you on Tuesday.
